svg.title: One host, three clients, three servers, and one connection each
svg.desc: A host panel on the left holds the model, the conversation and consent, and beneath them three client boxes labeled A, B and C that are otherwise identical. Each client draws exactly one arrow, marked one to one, across a dashed protocol boundary to its own server: client A to the files server, client B to the docs server, and client C to the db server. Two of the three servers are local processes and one is a remote service. Each server then reaches one dashed box outside MCP: a project folder, a documentation site, and a PostgreSQL database. No arrow joins one client to another, or one server to another.
svg.text: One host, three clients, three servers
Each client owns exactly one connection. Nothing about it is shared with another client.
Claude Desktop, Cursor, your own tool
- owns the conversation and its history
and creates one client per connected server
No client talks to another client, and no server sees another.
The dashed boxes sit outside MCP.
